tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every surface. Warm off-white by day, charcoal at night; never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tickets, the sidebar and the top bar. Text on it is ink, ink-2 or ink-3.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Row hover, wells inside a card (a sparkline bed), secondary buttons. Never a card inside a card.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers, card borders, table rules, the timeline spine. Always 1px solid.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: The rule under a table header, the outline of the Assistant bubble, an outlined secondary button.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface and surface-2. Also the text on an accent fill (see on-accent).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the why line under a queue item, sentences under a result, list metadata. 4.5:1 or better on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Hints, timestamps, source lines at 13px and above. 4.5:1 on ground and surface in both themes; never below 13px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand orange, as a FILL only: the primary button, the active nav bar, the Needs-you band, the hero card in Night Service. Text on it is on-accent, never white.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text, icon, link, sparkline stroke or focus detail. Passes 4.5:1 on ground and surface in its theme; the raw accent does not on light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button label, the Needs-you band). Dark ink, because white on orange fails contrast.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Text selection, the tint behind a Needs-you chip, the client's own message bubble. Text on it is status-needs or ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring at 2px offset on every interactive element, on any surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links; an alias of accent-ink so a theme that moves the accent moves links.

tokens.name: status-needs
tokens.usage: Text and icon for Needs you, Waiting on you and Needs approval, on status-needs-tint or on surface. Always with the alert icon and the word.

tokens.name: status-needs-tint
tokens.usage: Chip background behind status-needs text.

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: Text and icon for In progress, on status-progress-tint or on surface. Always with the quarter-circle icon and the word.

tokens.name: status-progress-tint
tokens.usage: Chip background behind status-progress text.

tokens.name: status-scheduled
tokens.usage: Text and icon for Scheduled, on status-scheduled-tint or on surface. Always with the clock icon and the word.

tokens.name: status-scheduled-tint
tokens.usage: Chip background behind status-scheduled text.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Text and icon for Done and Connected, on status-done-tint or on surface. Always with the check icon and the word; it differs from status-needs in lightness, not only hue.

tokens.name: status-done-tint
tokens.usage: Chip background behind status-done text.

tokens.name: status-paused
tokens.usage: Text and icon for Paused, Stale and Disconnected, on status-paused-tint or on surface. Always with the pause, clock or link-off icon and the word.

tokens.name: status-paused-tint
tokens.usage: Chip background behind status-paused text.

tokens.name: status-delayed
tokens.usage: Text and icon for Delayed, on status-delayed-tint or on surface, always with the clock icon, the word and the reason.

tokens.name: status-delayed-tint
tokens.usage: Chip background behind status-delayed text.

tokens.name: spectrum-red
tokens.usage: First stop of the brand spectrum. The spectrum is drawn only as the readiness progress line (a horizontal gradient through the six stops) and lives otherwise in the mark itself. Never a background, text fill or border.

tokens.name: spectrum-orange
tokens.usage: Second stop of the brand spectrum; see spectrum-red.

tokens.name: spectrum-yellow
tokens.usage: Third stop of the brand spectrum; see spectrum-red.

tokens.name: spectrum-green
tokens.usage: Fourth stop of the brand spectrum; see spectrum-red.

tokens.name: spectrum-blue
tokens.usage: Fifth stop of the brand spectrum; see spectrum-red.

tokens.name: spectrum-violet
tokens.usage: Sixth stop of the brand spectrum; see spectrum-red.

families.sans: "Be Vietnam Pro", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: t-figure
styles.usage: A result figure in a tile. Proportional figures; at most one figure larger than this per screen (a hero at 56px).

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: The page title, once per screen.

styles.name: t-heading
styles.usage: Section headings (Needs you, Current work, Recent results, Upcoming, Recent activity). Nothing sits above a heading.

styles.name: t-card-title
styles.usage: The title of a queue item, a service card, a result tile.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: They go out Mon, Wed and Fri. Nothing is scheduled until you approve.
styles.usage: Body copy: the why line, the plain sentence under a result, stream messages. Measure 45 to 75 characters.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: Source: Google Business Profile · Updated 2 hours ago
styles.usage: Metadata: source and updated lines, timestamps, due dates. In ink-3 or ink-2; never smaller.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Small labels over values (the five questions on a service card), field labels. Sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: t-button
styles.usage: Button and chip labels. Sentence case; the label names the action.

styles.name: t-tabular
styles.usage: Figures, dates and times in tables and aligned columns only (The Ledger direction). Never for headings or prose.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; gap between tiles in a strip.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding horizontal; gap between stacked rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone page padding; padding inside a compact card; the dot-grid pitch on the cover.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards at desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding at desktop; gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters at desktop; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading (more above than below).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between major sections on a long page.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Broadsheet and Ledger: square corners everywhere.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tickets, table cells with a tint, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, Board tiles, the cover's tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards in Front of House and Pocket; the default card radius.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sunroom cards; the largest card radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, the pill nav, status chips in Sunroom.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The only resting shadow, and only in directions that allow one (Sunroom cards, the Night Service hero). Offset and blurred, never a halo.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover lift on a ticket or a card that moves 2px up.
